title: Enhanced Input bindings capture null actions — SetupInputComponent runs before BeginPlay
detail: Verified in UE 5.8 source: PIE spawns PC via ULocalPlayer::SpawnPlayActor → SetPlayer → InitInputSystem → SetupInputComponent (GameInstance.cpp:538) BEFORE PlayWorld->BeginPlay() (:565). Bindings store null weak action ptrs; dispatch matches Binding.GetAction()==Action (EnhancedInputComponent.cpp:110) — never fires.
recommended_fix: Create the UInputActions in SetupInputComponent (or constructor) before binding, or re-bind in BeginPlay after creating them.

title: Camera fit computed once from always-zero geometry; never re-fit despite comment claiming it
detail: NativeTick never recomputes FitScale/FitOffset (only RebuildWorld does, called solely from BindRun at BeginPlay when geometry is zero). View always renders with the 1280x720 fallback fit while the command bus maps clicks using live GetViewportSize — misaligned on any other viewport size.
recommended_fix: Recompute FitScale/FitOffset in NativeTick from MyGeometry.GetLocalSize() when it changes (or before the topology rebuild), keeping view and bus mappings consistent.

title: Zero-size viewport path divides by zero in ScreenToGrid
detail: No guard for ViewportSize of 0. Engine's APlayerController::GetViewportSize sets SizeX=SizeY=0 first (overwrites the 1280/720 defaults); with no/zero viewport, Scale=0 → inf/NaN → FloorToDouble → int32 cast is UB.
recommended_fix: Early-out when ViewportSize.X/Y <= 0 (return the last known grid or a sentinel) before computing Scale.

title: Drawn pipe invisible until next 20 Hz sim tick — same-tick snapshot is gated on Tick change
detail: EndDraw rebuilds GameMode::Snapshot but Tick is unchanged, so the view's Tick-change gate skips adoption; the pipe renders only after the next driver step (up to 50 ms later), contradicting the 'THIS frame' intent.
recommended_fix: Also adopt the snapshot when Next.Pipes.Num() != CurSnapshot.Pipes.Num() while Tick is equal, or trigger the topology rebuild directly from EndDraw.

title: New packet dots glide in from map corner — PacketPrevPos seeded to ZeroVector
detail: First frame for every spawned (or pool-released-then-reused) packet id lerps from grid (0,0), so dots visibly slide in from the map's top-left corner instead of appearing at the source node.
recommended_fix: Seed PacketPrevPos with the packet's current position (PacketPosIn(CurSnapshot, Packet)) instead of ZeroVector on creation.

title: GetMousePosition return value ignored — failed read starts drag at (0,0)
detail: Engine GetMousePosition returns bool and leaves outputs at 0 on failure; both OnDrawStart and OnDrawEnd ignore it, silently drawing from/ending at the viewport corner.
recommended_fix: Check the bool return and skip BeginDraw/EndDraw when the position is unavailable.

title: Edit-rejection feedback state written but never read — rejected drags give no UI signal
detail: Grep confirms no reader anywhere in Source/; the status line prints only tick/packets/score. MissingNode/self_loop/span_exceeds rejections are silent to the player.
recommended_fix: Render LastEditError in the view's status text (e.g. append the error name when bHasLastEditError and Error != None).

title: U-E2 dirty-tree guard only inspects Config/ though it claims the whole tracked tree
evidence:
dirty_before="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
  run_gates "${#GATES[@]}"
  gate_rc=$?
  dirty_after="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ "$dirty_before" != "$dirty_after" ]; then
detail: Comment says 'the full suite (editor boots + probes) must not dirty the tracked tree', but the assertion covers Config/ only; a gate dirtying Source/, Content/, or docs/ (beyond the intentional timings.md append at line 120) passes undetected.
recommended_fix: Snapshot full 'git status --porcelain' minus the known-intentional docs/timings.md line, or document the Config/-only scope in the comment.
